- Hazards: Causes severe skin burns and eye damage (concentrate); Harmful if swallowed; Very toxic to aquatic life
- Handling: Dilute only as the label directs, in a ventilated area. Never decant the concentrate into an unlabelled bottle.
- Protective equipment: Chemical-resistant nitrile gloves and splash goggles when handling the concentrate
- Storage: Original labelled container, closed, upright, away from food and other chemicals
- Do not mix with: Never mix with bleach (sodium hypochlorite), anionic detergents or strong oxidisers
- First-aid measures (the sheet's own words, not medical advice): Skin: remove contaminated clothing and rinse skin with water for 15 minutes. Eyes: rinse with water for 15 minutes and call a poison centre or doctor. Swallowed: rinse mouth, do not induce vomiting, call a poison centre.
- Spills: Contain with absorbent; keep out of drains; dispose of as the label directs
